title: iOS Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**

We're looking for an **iOS Engineer** to build and scale the Atlys iOS app, helping millions of travellers apply for visas faster and with less uncertainty, right from their phones.

This role is for someone with a strong foundation in native iOS development who obsesses over performance, polish and reliability, and who enjoys owning features end to end.

**The Job**

* **Build and ship core app experiences** in Swift and SwiftUI across the visa journey, from discovery and document upload to payments and application tracking.
* **Own app quality and performance**, keeping launch time, crash rates, memory usage and app size in check across devices, iOS versions and network conditions.
* **Bring AI into the app** by turning AI-powered flows such as smart document capture, conversational assistance into fast, native experiences.
* **Ship fast with product, design and backend**, running experiments and iterating on features based on data.
* **Raise the engineering bar** through clean architecture, thoughtful code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 3-5 years of iOS development experience, including shipping and scaling at least one consumer app on the App Store.
* Are exceptionally strong in Swift, including Swift Concurrency (async/await), with hands-on experience in SwiftUI and UIKit.
* Have a solid grasp of modern app architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture or TCA), dependency injection and modularisation with Swift Package Manager.
* Have built robust networking and data layers using REST/GraphQL APIs, URLSession, Core Data or SwiftData, and offline-first patterns.
* Know how to measure and improve app health using tools such as Xcode Instruments, Firebase Crashlytics, XCTest and analytics or experimentation SDKs.

**Here's what you can expect:**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

title: QA Engineer (Mobile & Web)
description:
Ryan\-Miranda Partners is a small US\-based software firm.

We build and operate consumer mobile and web applications used by hundreds of thousands of people across iOS, Android, and the browser.

You would join our established India\-based engineering team and report to our lead engineer in Delhi. We work async: a short written plan in the morning, a short written summary in the evening, and very few meetings.

**About the role**

You are the last check before a release reaches users. Our senior developers build the features; your job is to take what they built, run it on every platform, and confirm it works before anyone else sees it. Eventually this role can get promotion.

To be upfront: this is not a feature\-development seat. It is closer to an SDET or release engineer than a manual testing role.

You will read Swift and TypeScript every day, drive three toolchains, and your verification is what lets the rest of the team ship quickly. What you will do

\- Reproduce bugs on real devices, confirm the fix, and check the screens around it

\- Check out branches and run our codebases on three platforms: iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), Android (React Native), and web (TypeScript/React)

\- First\-pass verification of pull requests: run the change on\-device, confirm it does what the ticket says, and write up what you found

\- Manual and regression testing on TestFlight and Google Play internal builds ahead of each release

\- Write clear reproduction steps and test cases in Jira

\- Post a short written plan each morning and a written summary each evening, like the rest of the team

\- Over time, build the automation that replaces your own manual passes: Maestro flows, snapshot suites, and CI checks

Pay: ₹65,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
